model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on the closing price of Cardano (ADA) for August 6, 2026, as reported in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko Cardano Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/cardano/historical_data) for the row dated 2026-08-06 (UTC daily close), read to four decimal places. Bands are inclusive of the lower bound and exclusive of the upper bound; for example, a close of exactly $0.1925 resolves to the $0.1925–$0.1950 band.
